Polygon Labs has completed its acquisition of Coinme, integrating regulated U.S. money transfer services into the Polygon Open Money Stack. The platform now covers 48 U.S. states, holding 37 state-level money transmitter licenses and 11 applicable exemptions, and is registered with FinCEN as a money services business. Tazapay, Mesh, Toku and Kira are the first customers, using it for cross-border business payments, account top-ups, global payroll and USD services. — link
